channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Huge 66-ft Turkish drones are hunting million-dollar Chinese UAVs in Africa in another war barely anyone talks about
item.description: Turkish and Chinese-made drones are fighting for control of Sudan's skies while civilian deaths from strikes keep climbing sharply.

item.title: Google Pixel 11 Review: Minor Upgrade
item.description: Incremental improvements fail to generate much excitement, but Google’s Pixel 11 is still an accomplished Android phone.

item.title: Amazon's God of War show brings in Dave Bautista as its new Kratos
item.description: The casting swap follows Ryan Hurst's injury on set earlier this year.

item.title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
item.description: Businesses are willing to flop back and forth as each lab releases new models, volatility that should give both companies' investors pause about how "sticky" enterprise AI spending really is.

item.title: GitHub says commits have doubled in the last four months
item.description: The new traffic peak caused "capacity failures" that led to the developer platform's recent outage.

item.title: USAF is buying banned DJI drones to train its operators against the 'most statistically probable real-world threat'
item.description: The US Air Force is buying restricted DJI drones for nuclear missile base training, seeking realistic exposure to commercial drone threats.

item.title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plug-in
item.description: Ever wanted someone else to do your texting for you? ChatGPT is being offered up as an automated text scribe via a new Apple Messages integration.

item.title: Quote of the day by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman: 'There's no way to get there without a breakthrough' — a blunt reality check on the path to superintelligent AI
item.description: Although AI models continue to improve in metrics and benchmarks, fundamental improvements may not come for a while

item.title: HyperX's first open-back gaming headset brings the bass
item.description: The Cloud Alpha Air is reasonably priced at $150 and sports super comfy earpads.

item.title: Want smarter screen time? This documentary streaming service is now $130 for life.
item.description: Learn while you relax with this lifetime subscription to MagellanTV Documentary Streaming Service, now only $129.97.

item.title: Apple Music will reportedly label any AI-made tracks later this year
item.description: The upcoming feature expands its Transparency Tags for marking slop songs.

item.title: Google Discover is getting an AI chatbot-tuned feed
item.description: Google will soon allow you to customize your Discover feed by describing what you want to see. The new feature, rolling out to the Google app in the "coming days," will use AI to automatically tweak your feed and "remember" your preferences for future visits. item.title: China's PLA used drones to send gold bars, US$100 notes in a bizarre 'wartime financial support' drill
item.description: Chinese troops rehearsed handling gold bars and multiple currencies, including Taiwanese dollars, in a drill raising questions about authenticity and intent.
